faq.q: What is the origin of Tawfiq?
faq.a: Tawfiq is associated with Arabic. Tawfiq is Arabic تَوْفِيق (Tawfīq), meaning 'success, divine guidance'.
Yes — the underlying form تَوْفِيق is Arabic.
Tawfiq can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Tawfiq should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root و ف ق is Quranic, but Tawfīq is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Tawfiq, tawfiq. Script forms are توفیق, تَوْفِيق, तौफ़ीक़.
